content.text:
=== Frontend served config ===
{
  "endPointUrl": "http://localhost:5000/api",
  "keycloak": {
    "realm": "my-realm",
    "authServerUrl": "http://localhost:8080/",
    "resource": "strassennamen"
  }
}

=== CORS preflight from 4200 origin ===
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:4200
=== CORS on real request ===
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:4200

observation.command: echo "=== Frontend served config ===" && curl -s http://localhost:4200/configs/config.development.json && echo && echo "=== CORS preflight from 4200 origin ===" && curl -s -i -X OPTIONS "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4200" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: GET" | grep -i "access-control\|HTTP/" && echo "=== CORS on real request ===" && TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=strassennamen&username=user1&password=user1pass" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && curl -s -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Origin: http://localhost:4200" "http://localhost:5000/api/Strasse" | grep -i "access-control\|HTTP/"
